title: App-Store Screenshot Frames (5 phones)
prompt: Five premium app-store screenshot frames for Ongea Pesa, shown as five phone mockups in a row on a deep teal-black background (#0A1A1F), each with a short bold caption above it in white. Phone 1 (caption 'Just speak.'): a clean home screen with a large glowing voice-command orb and a green-to-cyan waveform. Phone 2 (caption 'Send in seconds.'): a confirmation screen 'KES 2,000 sent' with a green check. Phone 3 (caption 'Your money, your voice.'): a balance card in teal with the emblem. Phone 4 (caption 'Chama made easy.'): a group-contribution screen. Phone 5 (caption 'Built in Nairobi.'): a branded splash with the emblem and 'by NSAIT'. Consistent teal UI, clean minimal screens (not overloaded), realistic phone frames, perfectly spelled, premium app-store quality.
negative_prompt: purple UI, overloaded dense dashboards, microphone clipart, dollar sign, stock people, misspelling, neon, low-res, distorted text, cluttered screens
notes: For Play Store / App Store listing. Keep each screen minimal — one idea per phone.
